scenarios.name: namespace_isolation
scenarios.note: Queue names are GLOBAL per database today (P1-2). A dequeue under another namespace must not see the job. Fails in all three languages until P1-2 namespaces queue names.

scenarios.name: nack_unknown_receipt_is_precondition
scenarios.note: A nack with a receipt this client never issued means the lease was lost; it must raise Precondition (stop the work), not silently succeed (P0-3).

scenarios.name: dequeue_zero_visibility_is_rejected
scenarios.note: visibility 0 is Invalid in the core. Node passes 0 through (gets Invalid); Python clamps to 1ms and succeeds — P0-5 gap for python.
